about: Project-knowledge bank (docs/PROJECT-KNOWLEDGE-PLAN.md P7). Every scenario is a conversation of one or more turns on the bowling fixture; `new_session: true` starts the turn in a new conversation of the same project. Expectations are structural (journal entries, the graph, files), never words in the prompt: `teaches` = a knowledge card was (true) or was not (false) proposed in the turn; `accept` = the runner keeps every card the turn proposed (and accepts its decision cards) before the next turn; `recalled` = an item kept earlier in the task is in this session's brief, in a knowledge note, or attached to a read; `file_contains` = a file written in the workspace holds one of the strings; `edits_only` = every edit of the turn is in these files; `read_carries_knowledge` = a read of this symbol carried a knowledge line; `section_read` = a read result shows a README section; `answer_contains_any` = the reply holds one of these; `brief_max_tokens` / `note_max_lines` = the cost ceilings.

bowling.planted: bowling/score.py: compute_hdcp (USBC handicap), frame_ten (bonus balls), game_total; bowling/series.py: series_total sums two rolls per frame and drops the tenth frame's bonus balls (the drift); README.md Scoring and Handicap sections; tests pass as shipped

refuted_rounding.text: The series total drift comes from rounding in frame ten.

turns: Our leagues do not use the USBC handicap. We play DBU handicap: 80% of the difference between 210 and the bowler's average, rounded down. Please keep that in mind for this project.
Write tests/test_hdcp_data.py with the expected handicap of a bowler averaging 180 under our league rules, as a single assertion against compute_hdcp.
scenarios.note: Session A teaches the league rule (a card, kept); session B must use it: DBU gives (210-180)*0.8 = 24, USBC would give 18.

turns: test_handicap_usbc fails for an average of 199: compute_hdcp returns 0 instead of 1. Fix it.

turns: Just so we are on the same page: in bowling a strike is knocking down all ten pins with the first ball, and a spare is doing it with both balls of the frame.
scenarios.note: General knowledge the model already has. Expected no card; the rate across runs is the measurement (the prompt's 'general knowledge is not an item' line is judged by it).

turns: The series total is off by the tenth frame's bonus balls in every game. Fix the bug and keep the tests green.
